title: Add customer review system with submission form and public display

requirements.text: Create a new ReviewsSection component positioned after the AboutSection in the App.tsx layout

quotes: Yes a new dedicated section on the homepage after the about section

acceptanceCriteria: ReviewsSection component exists in frontend/src/components/
Component is imported and rendered in App.tsx after AboutSection
Section has a distinct visual design consistent with existing sections

requirements.text: Build a review submission form in the ReviewsSection component with fields for star rating (1-5), customer name, service type dropdown, and written feedback textarea

quotes: let them write a 1-5 star review with their name and service type and how we did

acceptanceCriteria: Form includes star rating selector with 1-5 star options
Form includes text input for customer name
Form includes dropdown for service type matching existing services (Patio Polyaspartic Coating, Driveway Polyaspartic Coating, Pool Deck Polyaspartic Coating, Garage Floor Polyaspartic Coating)
Form includes textarea for written feedback about customer experience
Form has validation requiring all fields before submission
Form displays success message after successful submission

requirements.text: Add backend functions in backend/main.mo to submit, retrieve, and list customer reviews with fields for rating (Nat8), customerName (Text), serviceType (Text), feedback (Text), and timestamp (Int)

quotes: Let the reviews be Displayed to all visitors to the website

acceptanceCriteria: Review type defined in backend/main.mo with id, rating, customerName, serviceType, feedback, and timestamp fields
submitReview function accepts review data and stores it in a Map with auto-incrementing ID
getAllReviews function returns array of all stored reviews sorted by timestamp (newest first)
Reviews persist across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Create React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for submitting reviews and fetching all reviews from the backend actor

quotes: Let the reviews be Displayed to all visitors to the website

acceptanceCriteria: useSubmitReview mutation hook calls backend submitReview function
useGetAllReviews query hook calls backend getAllReviews function
Query automatically refetches after successful review submission
Hooks follow existing pattern from useQueries.ts

requirements.text: Display all submitted reviews in the ReviewsSection component showing star rating, customer name, service type, feedback text, and submission date for each review

quotes: all submitted reviews will be stored in the backend (Motoko canister) and displayed on the website for all visitors to see

acceptanceCriteria: Reviews displayed in card layout with visual hierarchy
Star rating shown visually (filled/empty stars)
Customer name and service type clearly labeled
Feedback text displayed prominently
Reviews sorted by date with newest first
Empty state shown when no reviews exist yet
Loading state shown while fetching reviews

constraints: Follow existing patterns from ContactSection.tsx for form validation and submission
Use existing color palette and styling from tailwind.config.js
Match service type options exactly with those in ContactSection dropdown
nonGoals: Editing or deleting reviews after submission
Review filtering or sorting by rating
